name: vault-core-invariants
description: Core security invariants for the example Vault contract (see examples/contracts/invariants/).

invariants.title: Only the owner may adjust reserves
invariants.description: adjustAssets changes the accounted reserve balance and must be owner-gated.
assumptions: 'owner' is set once in the constructor and is never the zero address

invariants.title: Reserves must never fall below outstanding debt
assumptions: totalAssets/totalDebt are only ever mutated by contract functions, never by direct storage writes elsewhere

invariants.title: Balance is debited before the external transfer (checks-effects-interactions)
adjustAssets() validates its delta before writing to totalAssets
assumptions: 'delta' is the only externally-controlled input to this function

invariants.title: Every function reachable from borrow() that touches reserves is guarded
